sources.entry: Chartbrew - Connect directly to databases and APIs and use the data to create beautiful charts. (Demo, Source Code) MIT Nodejs/Docker

summary.one_liner: Chartbrew is an open-source web app that connects directly to databases and APIs and turns the data into charts and dashboards.
summary.what_it_does: Connects directly to databases and APIs and uses the returned data to build charts. Includes a chart builder, editable dashboards, embeddable charts, a query and requests editor, and team capabilities. Runs as a self-hosted Node.js server and client, backed by MySQL or PostgreSQL and Redis. The README points to an external page for the list of supported data sources. It also documents a Docker quickstart that exposes the app on ports 4018 and 4019 and a BullMQ admin dashboard at /apps/queues protected by HTTP Basic Auth.
use_cases: create charts from REST API data
self-host a BI or reporting tool
how_to_run: Create an empty MySQL or PostgreSQL database for Chartbrew
git clone the repository, then run: cd chartbrew && npm run setup
Set the required environment variables in chartbrew/.env
Development: run 'npm run start' in client/ and 'npm run start-dev' in server/ in two terminals
Docker: docker pull razvanilin/chartbrew, then docker run with the CB_* database, Redis, and encryption key variables as shown in the README
notable: Connects directly to databases and APIs without a separate data pipeline
Docker image published on each release
Hosted service also available, with one-click deploy partners listed
caveats: Requires MySQL or PostgreSQL plus Redis, so setup involves several services
Full setup details are in external documentation, not the README
Deploy buttons for DigitalOcean and Hostinger are affiliate links
